# <span id="aanchor104"></span> Formula Statement Editors

Use the formula statement editors to enter calculated meter formulas consisting of calculated meter members, numbers, and basic arithmetic operators. To ensure consistency, editing is done using buttons to insert components, rather than manually typing in components. This helps users adhere to the syntactical rules required by the parser of the Calculated Meter Rollup service.

For details about how the Calculated Meter Rollup service applies the formula entered in these editor, see: [Calculated Meter Rollup Process](Calculated%20Meter%20Rollup%20Process.md).

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="IF Statement">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />IF Statement Editor</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="IF Statement">

An IF statement contains a left side, right side, and an inequality operator.

An IF statement determines whether a DO and ELSE DO calculation will take place if the conditions are met; it does not specify how the calculation is performed. The calculation method is specified by DO and ELSE DO statements.

<div class="procedure">

To configure an IF statement:

1.  Select a resolution and data point to specify what the condition will be based on. The default selections are Hourly (resolution) and Volume (data point). The following resolutions and data points are supported:

1.  Select a side to edit. Click the display boxes located on either side of the inequality drop-down. The activated side will be white; the deactivated side will be grey.
2.  Select an inequality operator to be used for the IF evaluation using the drop-down. The following operators are supported:

> - **\>** (is greater than)
> - **\<** (is less than)
> - **=** (is equal to)
> - **\>=** (is greater than or equal to)
> - **\<=** (is less than or equal to)
> - **\<\>** (is less than or greater than)

1.  Refer to <a href="#Common" class="InlineLink">Common Edit Form Components</a> for details about the other features on this screen.

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="DO Statement">

Use the DO Statement Editor to specify how the calculated meter values will be calculated when the IF statement is determined to be true. For each measurement hour where the IF statement is true, quantities of the calculated meter will be calculated as specified. See: [Calculated Meter Rollup Process](Calculated%20Meter%20Rollup%20Process.md)

Refer to <a href="#Common" class="InlineLink">Common Edit Form Components</a> for details about the other features on this screen.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 562;height: 212;" />

</div>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="ELSE DO Statement">

Use the ELSE DO Statement Editor to specify the calculation to be performed when the IF statement is determined to be false. For each measurement hour where the IF statement is false, quantities of the calculated meter will be calculated as specified. See: [Calculated Meter Rollup Process](Calculated%20Meter%20Rollup%20Process.md)

Refer to <a href="#Common" class="InlineLink">Common Edit Form Components</a> for details about the other features on this screen.

<span id="Common"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Common">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Common Edit Form Components</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Common">

To ensure consistency, statements cannot be manually typed in; they are edited using textboxes and buttons on the edit form.

Components are enabled only when it is syntactically appropriate to use them.

Insert the following items into your statement:

- **Arithmetic components** - Click the buttons to enter the necessary components.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 163;height: 47;" />

- **Members** - Select the Meter or Location radio button. Members of the calculated meter will display in the drop-down. Select the number in the drop-down and click the **Insert** button. Each statement can contain up to 10 members.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 288;height: 49;" />

When a member is inserted, “M.” or “L.” is added to the beginning of the object number to indicate the object type (meter or location, respectively) for parsing.

- **Constants** - Enter the value in the textbox and click the Insert button.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 181;height: 45;" />

### Statement Display Box

The statement display box concatenates the specified components and displays the result. This text box is read-only; you cannot type in the statement to edit. Editing occurs only at the end of the statements. The content can be selected and copied into other text editors.

The following function buttons are available:

- **Backspace** - Delete the element entered last in the current display box.
- **Clear** - Delete all elements entered in the current display box.
- **Validate** - Trigger a validation of what has been currently entered for the statement for syntactical errors. (See: [Validation and Error Messages](Validation%20and%20Error%20Messages.md))
- **Apply** - Store the statement and close the edit form. Clicking this button applies the same syntax validation as the Validate button. The statement must pass the validation in order for the form to be closed and the statement to be stored.
- **Cancel** - Discards edits made during the current session and close the form.

</div>
